info.title: RaceDay API
info.description: REST API for the RaceDay event management system. Log in with POST /api/auth/login first; the session cookie is then sent automatically by Swagger UI for later calls.

post.summary: Register a new Participant or Organiser account.
post.description:
Public endpoint. Participants can self-register. Organiser registration needs the organiser invite code
set by the system administrator (Registration:OrganiserInviteCode). If no code is configured, Organiser
registration is closed. Organisers must also supply CompanyName and RegistrationNumber.
Passwords are stored as BCrypt hashes.

201.description: Account created. Returns the new user (log in next).

400.description: Validation failed (for example a short password, invalid role, or missing organiser fields).

403.description: Organiser invite code missing or incorrect, or Organiser registration is closed.

409.description: Email address or registration number already in use.

post.summary: Log in and start a server-side session that stores the user ID and role.
post.description:
On success the response sets the session cookie (.RaceDay.Session). Swagger UI and the browser send it
automatically on later calls. Any previous session data is discarded first.

post.summary: End the current session and clear the session cookie.

get.summary: Renew the current session and return the logged-in user.
get.description: Equivalent of issuing a fresh token: resets the 30-minute idle timeout. Use it to keep a session alive.

401.description: Not logged in, or the account no longer exists (the session is then cleared).

get.summary: List the categories of an event (public).

post.summary: Add a category to an event you organise.
post.description: Blocked for events that have already taken place. Category names must be unique within the event (case-insensitive).

403.description: Event belongs to another organiser, or the caller is not an organiser.

409.description: Duplicate name, or the event has already taken place.

put.summary: Update a category of an event you organise.
put.description: Changing a category does not affect enrolments already made. The age restriction is checked only when someone enrols.

409.description: Duplicate name, or the event has already taken place.

delete.summary: Delete a category of an event you organise.
delete.description: Blocked while any active enrolment (Registered, Started or Completed) uses the category. Withdrawn enrolments are removed with it.

409.description: Active enrolments exist, or the event has already taken place.

get.summary: List your own enrolments, including withdrawn ones and any results.

post.summary: Enrol in an event by choosing one of its categories.
post.description:
Rules: the event must not have started; you cannot enrol twice in the same category; age-restricted categories
need a date of birth on your profile and an age on the event date at or above the restriction; and the event
capacity (MaxParticipants) must not be exceeded. A previously withdrawn enrolment in the same category is
reactivated rather than duplicated.

400.description: Age restriction not met, or date of birth missing for an age-restricted category.

409.description: Already enrolled, event started, or event full.

delete.summary: Withdraw from an event (your own enrolment).
delete.description:
The enrolment is kept with status Withdrawn so history is preserved. It is not allowed once the event has started,
once a result exists, or if it is already withdrawn.

403.description: The enrolment belongs to another participant, or caller is not a participant.

409.description: Already withdrawn, completed, or the event has started.

get.summary: List every enrolment for an event you organise.
get.description: Includes withdrawn enrolments, marked with their status. Participant names and email addresses are returned.

403.description: Event belongs to another organiser, or the caller is not an organiser.

get.description: Each event includes its categories. Optional filters: eventType, and upcomingOnly to hide events that have started.

parameters.name: upcomingOnly
parameters.description: When true, only events whose date is in the future are returned.

400.description: eventType is not a recognised value.

post.summary: Create an event owned by the logged-in organiser.
post.description: The event date must be in the future. Categories may be supplied now or added later. Category names must be unique within the event.

201.description: Event created. Returns the event with its categories.

400.description: Validation failed (for example a past date or duplicate category names).

403.description: Logged in as a participant, or the organiser profile is missing.

get.summary: Get one event with its categories (public).

put.summary: Update an event that you organise.
put.description: A new date must be in the future. Capacity cannot be set below the number of active (non-withdrawn) enrolments.

409.description: Capacity is below the current number of enrolments.

delete.summary: Delete an event that you organise.
delete.description:
Blocked while any enrolment is still active (Registered, Started or Completed). Withdrawn enrolments are
removed with the event. Categories are deleted with the event.

409.description: The event still has active enrolments.

get.description:
The participant sees their full history. An organiser sees only the enrolments in their own events.
Any other user receives an empty list.

403.description: Caller is neither the participant nor an organiser.

post.summary: Record the finish time and position for an enrolment in an event you organise.
post.description: Only allowed after the event date, once per enrolment, and not for withdrawn enrolments. The enrolment status changes to Completed.

403.description: Event belongs to another organiser, or the caller is not an organiser.

409.description: Event has not taken place, enrolment withdrawn, or result already recorded.

get.summary: Get the result for an enrolment.
get.description: Visible to the participant who owns the enrolment and to the organiser of that event. Anyone else receives 403.

403.description: Not the participant or the organiser for this enrolment.

404.description: Enrolment not found, or no result recorded yet.

get.description: Any logged-in user can view basic details. The email address is returned only to the account owner.

put.summary: Update your own account and profile.
put.description:
Only the account owner can call this. Account fields (name, email, optional password) apply to every role.
Participants update DateOfBirth and EmergencyContact. Organisers update CompanyName and RegistrationNumber,
which are required. Fields for the other role are ignored.

403.description: Attempting to update another user's account.

409.description: Email or registration number already belongs to another account.

get.description: Only the account owner can view the profile. Participants see date of birth and emergency contact. Organisers see company and registration details.

403.description: Attempting to view another user's profile.

categoryName.description: Category label, unique within the event.

entryFee.description: Entry fee in ZAR (0 or more).

ageRestriction.description: Optional minimum age on the event date.

CategoryRequest.description: Body for adding or updating a category (for example "Under 20" or "10km").

CategoryResponse.description: A category belonging to an event.

eventDate.description: Start date and time. Must be in the future. Send an offset such as +02:00 or Z.

maxParticipants.description: Optional capacity. Each enrolment uses one place.

categories.description: Optional categories to create with the event.

CreateEventRequest.description: Body for POST /api/events. Categories are optional and can also be added later.

categoryId.description: ID of the category to enter.

EnrolmentSummaryResponse.description: A participant's enrolment, with event, category and result (when recorded).

EventEnrolmentResponse.description: An enrolment as seen by the organiser of the event.

enrolmentId.description: The enrolment the result belongs to.

timeCompletedSeconds.description: Finish time in whole seconds (greater than 0).

RecordResultRequest.description: Body for POST /api/results. Recorded by the organiser after the event.

email.description: Login email address. Must be unique; stored lower-case.

password.description: Plain-text password, at least 6 characters. Stored only as a BCrypt hash.

organiserInviteCode.description: Required when Role is Organiser. Issued by the system administrator (Registration:OrganiserInviteCode).

companyName.description: Required for Organisers: company or club name.

registrationNumber.description: Required for Organisers: unique registration number.

dateOfBirth.description: Optional for Participants. Needed to enter age-restricted categories.

emergencyContact.description: Optional for Participants: emergency contact name and number.

expiresInMinutes.description: Idle timeout; the session is renewed on each call to this endpoint.

eventDate.description: Start date and time. A new date must be in the future.

maxParticipants.description: Optional capacity. Cannot be lower than the number of active enrolments.

UpdateEventRequest.description: Body for PUT /api/events/{id}. Categories are managed through the category endpoints.

email.description: Email address. Must not belong to another account.

password.description: Optional new password (at least 6 characters). Leave null to keep the current password.

companyName.description: Organiser: company or club name (required for Organisers).

registrationNumber.description: Organiser: registration number (required for Organisers, must be unique).

UpdateUserRequest.description:
Body for PUT /api/users/{id}. Account fields apply to every role. Participant fields
(DateOfBirth, EmergencyContact) apply to Participants; CompanyName and RegistrationNumber apply to Organisers.
Fields that do not apply to the account's role are ignored.

UserProfileResponse.description: Role-specific profile returned to the account owner.

UserResponse.description: Basic user details. Email is included only for the account owner.
